design_rationale: Participants were explicitly assigned to strict or mild blood-pressure targets by a central registration office using a computer-generated randomization list.

domain_judgments.rationale: A computer-generated sequence was implemented centrally after registration, providing adequate random allocation and concealment, and the reported baseline characteristics were well balanced.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Immediately after registration, the registration office randomly assigned the subject to either treatment group using a computer-generated list and informed the investigators of the treatment assignments.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although this was an open-label trial and treatment intensity necessarily differed between groups, these differences were part of the assigned strategies, discontinuation was balanced, and effects were analyzed according to intention to treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The effects of the two treatments were compared according to the intention to treat.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome follow-up was unavailable for only 35 participants (1.6%) in the strict-treatment group and 38 (1.7%) in the mild-treatment group, making material bias from missing outcomes unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: When follow-up inquiries were sent to the subjects who discontinued treatment, responses were not obtained from 35 subjects (1.6%) in the strict-treatment group and 38 (1.7%) in the mild-treatment group (p=0.71).

domain_judgments.rationale: Clinical endpoints were prespecified, defined using appropriate objective diagnostic criteria, and adjudicated by a committee blinded to treatment assignment and blood-pressure course.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Endpoints were evaluated by the members of the Endpoint Evaluation Committee, who were blinded to the treatment assignments and the time course of BP.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered and its primary and secondary endpoints were specified, but the supplied report does not establish that a detailed prespecified statistical analysis plan was finalized before unblinded analysis, and it presents exploratory subgroup and interaction analyses with potential analytic flexibility.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This study was registered at the UMIN Clinical Trial Registry with the trial number UMIN000001021.

overall_summary: Randomization and central allocation were adequate, baseline balance was good, missing outcome data were minimal and balanced, intention-to-treat analysis was used, and blinded endpoint adjudication limited measurement bias. Overall risk is some concerns because the report does not confirm a prespecified, finalized analysis plan sufficient to exclude selective choice among analyses, particularly for the exploratory subgroup findings.

paper_title: 044df746_J of Clinical Hypertension - 2013 - Wei - Effects of Intensive Antihypertensive Treatment on Chinese Hypertensive Patients
design_rationale: The study explicitly reports that 724 participants were randomly assigned to intensive or standard treatment using a computer-generated table of random numbers.

domain_judgments.rationale: The sequence was explicitly computer-generated and measured baseline characteristics were balanced, but allocation concealment until assignment was not described.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 724 hypertensive patients older than 70 years were randomly assigned to either intensive antihypertensive treatment or standard treatment by using a computer-generated table of random numbers.

domain_judgments.rationale: This open-label trial used different treatment intensities as intended and reports an intention-to-treat analysis, but participant and treating-clinician awareness could have influenced adherence or co-interventions, and the handling of censoring is not fully consistent with a clearly described ITT treatment-effect analysis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This was a prospective, randomized, open-label, blinded-endpoint assessment (PROBE) study

domain_judgments.rationale: The authors state that all randomized participants were included for their observed follow-up, but they do not report the number, balance, or reasons for losses to follow-up, so bias from informative censoring cannot be excluded.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants who were lost to follow-up or died of other causes were censored and were also included in the final analyses for the actual follow-up period.

domain_judgments.rationale: Clinical endpoints were defined using objective diagnostic criteria and adjudicated by a committee blinded to treatment assignment and BP course, making differential outcome ascertainment unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Endpoints were evaluated by the members of the Endpoint Evaluation Committee, who were blinded to the treatment assignments and the time course of BP.

domain_judgments.rationale: Primary and secondary endpoints are specified in the article, but no preregistration or prespecified statistical analysis plan is reported, and numerous component outcomes and analyses leave scope for selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary endpoint was the combined incidence of fatal/nonfatal stroke, acute myocardial infarction, and other cardiovascular deaths (sudden death and heart failure death).

overall_summary: Overall, the trial has some concerns because allocation concealment was not reported, the open-label design and incompletely described censoring may permit bias, and no preregistration or analysis plan was provided. Blinded adjudication with objective endpoint definitions lowers concern for outcome measurement.

design_rationale: Participants were explicitly assigned 1:1 to intensive or standard systolic blood-pressure targets using a central computerized randomization program on a Web-based interface, stratified by clinical center.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was centrally computer-generated through a Web interface, which supports sequence randomness and concealment, and baseline characteristics were well balanced.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomization was performed with the use of a central computerized randomization program on a Web-based interface, with stratification according to clinical center.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although participants and investigators knew assignments as required for target-based treatment, the groups achieved sustained separation in blood pressure, follow-up continued after intervention discontinuation, and analyses followed intention to treat, with no reported unbalanced deviations likely to bias the effect estimate.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Investigators and patients were aware of the trial-group assignments. ... All analyses were based on the intention-to-treat approach.

domain_judgments.rationale: Only 2.7% of randomized participants were lost to follow-up, and all randomized participants were retained in the intention-to-treat time-to-event analysis with censoring at their last follow-up, making material bias from missing outcomes unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 234 patients (2.7%) were lost to follow-up before the end of the trial... Patients who were lost to followup were included in the final analysis, with data censored at the time of the last follow-up visit.

domain_judgments.rationale: Clinical outcomes had defined ascertainment criteria and were adjudicated by a committee blinded to treatment assignment, limiting differential measurement despite the open-label treatment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Definitions and ascertainment criteria for the trial outcomes are provided in Table S1. Members of the adjudication committee were unaware of the trial-group assignments.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary and secondary outcomes and subgroup analyses were prespecified, the protocol and complete statistical analysis plan were available, and the primary analysis matched the stated plan, providing little indication of selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The following secondary outcomes were prespecified... Prespecified subgroup analyses were performed for the primary outcome... The complete statistical analysis plan is included in the Supplementary Appendix.

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is low. Central computerized randomization, balanced baseline characteristics, intention-to-treat analysis with minimal loss to follow-up, blinded outcome adjudication, and prespecified outcomes and analyses support low risk across all RoB 2 domains.

design_rationale: The study explicitly reports prospective random assignment of enrolled patients by the VALISH Data Center to strict versus moderate systolic blood-pressure targets.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation was performed centrally with balancing factors and groups were largely comparable, but the report does not describe how the random sequence was generated or explicitly confirm concealment until assignment, and smoking differed at baseline.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: After obtaining written informed consent from all of the patients for the study, the patients were randomly assigned by the VALISH Data Center according to the following factors; sex, age (≤75 or >75 years), systolic BP (<175 or ≥175 mm Hg), antihypertensive therapy, and institution (weighting coefficient: 2).

domain_judgments.rationale: Although treatment was open-label, both groups followed prespecified target-based treatment algorithms, achieved distinct blood-pressure levels, and the primary analysis included all assigned patients on an intention-to-treat basis, with no important unbalanced deviations evident.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All of the registered study patients assigned to treatment were analyzed on an intentionto-treat basis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome follow-up was unavailable for 181 of 3260 randomized patients (5.6%), and no group-specific missingness or analysis demonstrating that missing outcomes could not bias the effect estimate was reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Because 181 patients were lost to follow-up, 3079 were followed up until March 2008 or for ≥2.5 years.

domain_judgments.rationale: Cardiovascular outcomes were prespecified and adjudicated by a blinded endpoint committee, reducing the likelihood that the open-label intervention influenced outcome assessment, although some composite components such as hospitalization could involve clinical judgment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: End points and adverse events were blindly evaluated according to the prospective, randomized, open-label, blinded end point design by the endpoint committee and the safety committee, respectively.

domain_judgments.rationale: A statistical analysis plan and prespecified primary endpoint and subgroup analyses are reported, but no accessible prospective trial registration or protocol/SAP comparison is provided to rule out selection among eligible analyses or outcome definitions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Statistical analysis was performed by Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories, Ltd according to the statistical analysis plan approved by the statistics committee (see Appendix).

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is some concerns, driven by incomplete reporting of sequence generation and allocation concealment, 5.6% loss to follow-up without sufficient sensitivity assessment, and inability to fully exclude selective reporting. Intention-to-treat analysis and blinded endpoint adjudication reduce concerns in the other domains.
